The Bohr radius a_0 is given by the formula:
a_0 = (4 * pi * epsilon_0 * h-bar^2) / (m_e * e^2)

Relevant constants:
Permittivity of free space epsilon_0 = 8.854 * 10^-12 F/m
Reduced Planck constant h-bar = 1.055 * 10^-34 J*s
Electron mass m_e = 9.109 * 10^-31 kg
Elementary charge e = 1.602 * 10^-19 C

Calculation:
a_0 = (4 * pi * 8.854 * 10^-12 * (1.055 * 10^-34)^2) / (9.109 * 10^-31 * (1.602 * 10^-19)^2)
a_0 approx 5.29 * 10^-11 m
